summary: Diagnosed cache staleness bug caused by missing cache invalidation hook in link update mutation.
evidence: Identified root cause: update_link service modified PostgreSQL but omitted cache_service.invalidate_redirect_target call, causing subsequent redirects to serve stale cached destination.
Verified failure symptom via pytest test_cache_invalidation_on_update failing with AssertionError: 'https://original.example.com' != 'https://updated-target.example.org'.
Prescribed remediation: invoke cache_service.invalidate_redirect_target(link.code) immediately after committing DB update.
